{"reason": "v1 pays 45000 for 34 supplier switches, many needless: failure rows with inventory-days 10-13.2 have regular-lead <=8, so a free monitor arrives before stockout. Added a monitor branch for medium/high risk with inventory-days >=9. Also widened expedite to medium risk at <5.5 days, covering the 5.3- and 2.8-day rows that cost 195000 with stockout.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 5.5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (>= inventory-days 9))
     (list 'monitor))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
